verdict.rationale: Morph documents an OpenAI-compatible base URL that any OpenAI SDK can point at. Existing OpenAI code only needs a new `model` string, and Morph also serves the Anthropic Messages API natively, so agents can move on or off without provider-specific code. Migration and canary flows that keep the current provider while routing a slice of traffic are also documented, and hands-on community reports confirm the OpenAI-compatible endpoint works with third-party tools and alongside other providers. Missing for 10: no published OpenAPI spec (all probe paths 404) and no detailed documentation of parameter-level compatibility such as tool calling or streaming parity.
